diagrams.title: Board Grid Layered Flow
diagrams.content:
flowchart TD
  subgraph s1["Presentation Layer"]
    n_root["GridView.tsx root scroll container"]
    n_bands["Band sections ordered Goals -> Tasks -> Messages -> Artifacts"]
    n_grid["Per-band responsive tile grid"]
    n_tile["Kind-banded tile button"]
    n_placeholder["Placeholder banner when the panel is too narrow"]
  end

  subgraph s2["State and Interaction Layer"]
    n_split["gridBands.ts split logic"]
    n_query["Container query breakpoints"]
    n_resize["ResizeObserver narrow-panel check"]
    n_focus["Keyboard focus and press handling"]
    n_modal_state["Modal state for goal, artifact, and message detail"]
  end

  subgraph s3["Domain Data Layer"]
    n_messages["Hydrated messages prop"]
    n_grouped["Grouped board items by kind"]
    n_badge["MessageTypeBadge semantic color and label"]
  end

  subgraph s4["Modal Boundary"]
    n_goal_modal["GoalDetailModal"]
    n_artifact_modal["ArtifactModal"]
    n_message_modal["MessageDetailModal with focus trap"]
  end

  n_messages --> n_split
  n_split --> n_grouped
  n_grouped --> n_bands
  n_bands --> n_grid
  n_query --> n_grid
  n_resize --> n_placeholder
  n_grid --> n_tile
  n_badge --> n_tile
  n_focus --> n_tile
  n_tile --> n_modal_state
  n_modal_state --> n_goal_modal
  n_modal_state --> n_artifact_modal
  n_modal_state --> n_message_modal
  n_root --> n_query
  n_root --> n_resize
  n_root --> n_focus
